title: 第21章 聪明人之间的信任第22章 意外的发现
slug: 废墟探险家第325章回魂芭
content_zh:
“亲爱的，你觉得列夫死了没有？”
走在前面的冲锋枪男人颇为期待的问道，“还有，这里是什么味道？闻起来让人很有食欲的香味。”
“肯定没有死”
走在后面的提灯女人狠毒的说道，“我们这一路上遇到的防爆门都被人打开而且上锁了，要么是他已经逃走了，要么是有人进来了。
总之，不管是什么情况，等下只要遇到人直接杀死，谁也别想抢走属于我们的东西。”
“当初我们就该杀了他”冲锋枪男人说道。
“还是让他品尝一下黑暗吧”
提灯女人的语气颇为期待，“说不定他已经死了呢，如果不需要我们动手是最好的。”
“我确实不想杀人”
冲锋枪男人贪婪的看着沿途的防爆门，“这里保存的这些东西能卖一大笔钱，足够我们移民美国然后成为富翁了。”
“我可不打算去美国”
提灯女人说到这里抬高了声音，“好了，就是这里了，哥哥，让你的人快点把这些破门都打开吧。谢尔盖，我们去看看列夫还活着没有。”
“遇到有人就开枪”
冲锋枪男人迈开步子之前不忘补充道，“这里又有人来过，说不定还没离开呢。”
“如果打死了人怎么办？”跟着过来的一个男人一边放下背着的气瓶一边问道。
“只要找个房间锁起来就好了”那个女人满不在乎的给出了近乎完美的标准答案。
1号防爆门的另一侧，几乎将耳朵贴在门板上的白芑和柳芭奇卡以及稍晚些赶来的虞娓娓对视了一眼，随后三人结伴走向了竖井的方向。
“我们现在有两种选择”
虞娓娓说道，“只要封死这扇门，短时间不用担心他们。”
“然后我们从那条通往植物园的防爆门逃走吗？”

白芑反问道，“首先，通往植物园的防爆门在门缝周围已经生锈，很可能打开之后会有地下水涌进来。
其次，地下工厂有我看中的东西，我可没打算拱手让人。”
“那就不用选了”
虞娓娓话音未落，已经从快拔枪套里抽出了那支拧着消音器的P22小手枪，“我们去解决掉外面的那些人吧。”
“倒也不用这么急”
白芑连忙摆手，他现在几乎可以确认，这个虞娓娓也只是看起来正常，但实质是并不比柳芭正常多少。
“你有什么打算？”虞娓娓反问道。
“难得有人帮我们开门”
白芑低声说道，“让他们先忙一会儿，等他们打开一扇门的时候我们再动手。”
“等下要杀了他们吗？”柳芭奇卡低声问道。
“你觉得呢？”虞娓娓却把这个问题抛给了白芑。
“咔嚓”
白芑给手中的霰弹枪顶上一颗闪光震撼弹作为回应，“用不上，而且就算杀死他们，大概也不需要我们动手。”
“列夫？”虞娓娓立刻猜到了白芑的心思。
“他肯定非常乐意做这些事的”
白芑说着已经按住通讯耳机轻声说道，“锁匠，你去8号防爆门里面的最尽头，那里有一堆人骨，人骨的旁边有一支PSS小手枪。
拿上那支小手枪，然后和列夫先生一起上来吧。”
“有人跟上来了？”锁匠立刻意识到了不妙。
“是列夫先生的妻子和搭档，当然，或许还有他们的朋友。”
白芑说这话的时候，顺便朝着虞娓娓微微点了点头。
content_en:
"Honey, do you think Lev is dead?"
The man with the submachine gun walking in front asked expectantly, "Also, what does it smell like here? It smells very appetizing."
"Definitely not dead"
The woman with a lantern walking behind said viciously, "All the blast doors we encountered along the way have been opened and locked. Either he has escaped or someone has come in.
In short, no matter what the situation is, if we kill someone directly later, no one can try to take away what belongs to us. "
"We should have killed him in the first place," the man with the submachine gun said.
"Let him taste the darkness."
The woman with the lantern said in a rather expectant tone, "Maybe he is already dead. It would be best if we don't need to do anything."
"I really don't want to kill anyone."
The man with the submachine gun looked greedily at the blast doors along the way, "These things kept here can be sold for a lot of money, enough for us to immigrate to the United States and become rich."
"I'm not going to the United States"
The woman with the lantern raised her voice at this point, "Okay, this is it. Brother, let your people open these broken doors quickly. Sergey, let's go see if Lev is still alive."
"Shoot when you see someone"
Before the man with the submachine gun took a step forward, he did not forget to add, "Someone has been here again, maybe they haven't left yet."
"What if someone is killed?" A man who followed asked as he put down the gas bottle he was carrying.
"Just find a room and lock it up." The woman gave an almost perfect standard answer nonchalantly.
On the other side of the explosion-proof door No. 1, Bai Qi and Liubachka, who almost put their ears against the door panel, and Yu Weiwei, who arrived a little later, looked at each other, and then the three of them walked towards the shaft together.
"We now have two options"
Yu Weiwei said, "As long as we seal this door, we don't have to worry about them for a short time."
"Then we escape through the blast door leading to the botanical garden?"
Bai Qi asked, "First of all, the explosion-proof door leading to the botanical garden has rusted around the door crack, and it is likely that groundwater will flow in after it is opened.
Secondly, the underground factory has something I like, and I have no intention of giving it away to anyone else. "
"Then there's no need to choose."
Before Yu Wei finished speaking, she had already pulled out the small P22 pistol with a silencer from the quick-draw holster, "Let's go and deal with those people outside."
"There's no need to be in such a hurry."
Bai Zhi waved his hand quickly. He could almost confirm now that this Yu Weiwei only looked normal, but in reality she was no more normal than Liuba.
"What are your plans?" Yu Weiwei asked.
“It’s rare for someone to open the door for us.”
Bai Zhi whispered, "Let them be busy for a while, and we will take action when they open a door."
"Are you going to kill them later?" Lyubachka asked in a low voice.
"What do you think?" Yu Weiwei asked Bai Qi this question.
"Click"
Bai Qi responded by adding a flash shock grenade to the shotgun in his hand, "It's useless, and even if we kill them, we probably won't need to do anything."
"Lev?" Yu Weiwei immediately guessed Bai Qi's thoughts.
"He must be very happy to do these things."
Bai Qi held down the communication headset and said softly, "Locksmith, go to the end of explosion-proof door No. 8. There is a pile of human bones there, and there is a small PSS pistol next to the human bones.
Get that little pistol and come up with Mr. Lev. "
"Is someone following?" The locksmith immediately realized something was wrong.
"Mr. Lev's wife and partner, and, of course, perhaps their friends."
When Bai Zhi said this, he nodded slightly towards Yu Weiwei.
